title: 第20章 三分钟第21章 进展
content_zh:
陈冲和彭维两人在练功房正中相对而立，嘈杂的拳手们都尽量往后退，给他们腾出了位置。
住在这栋楼的雷龙正式拳手们，约莫有七成的人都在这里了。
彭维看着陈冲，沉声道
“我练的是绞技，杀伤力很大，你等会支撑不住第一时间赶快认输，不要勉强。”
陈冲有些意外的看了他一眼，没想到他还如此敞亮，便也点点头
“好的，你也一样。”
“……”
彭维眼睛眯了眯，不再说话。
随着一个暂时充当裁判的拳手在旁边一声“开始”，两人都进入了状态。
陈冲摆出了标准的“于氏”搏击操的架子。
双手抱架在胸，可上可下；双脚交替点地，可攻可守。
而对面彭维则和他明显不同，明明身高比他高出不少，身躯却伏得更低，一双长臂微微前探，似乎随时准备把他扑倒。
两人正面相对，维持着固定的距离，开始缓缓变换着位置。
试探片刻，彭维微微点头，见陈冲没有明显的破绽，干脆的一步踏上便拉近了距离，双臂往陈冲腰间探去！
陈冲呼吸一变，带着奇异的韵律，周身血液瞬间加速，力量和反应便一下都提了上来。
他精准的捕捉到了彭维双手的轨迹，抱架一开，双手速度极快的拍向对手的小臂，将对方一双猿臂瞬间便拍开！
彭伟心中一惊，没想到自己的起手就这么被轻易的格挡开来，露出了胸中的空门。
眼见陈冲一掌拍来，他却夷然不惧，眼中精光闪烁。
不熟悉他的对手会以为他的双手拉扯才是主力，尽量避免；然而对战过的才知道，他如同蟒蛇的长腿亦是杀招。
上半身的攻势被化解，但他的左腿已经到了陈冲的脚下。

只需要轻轻一扫，打乱他的重心，到了地面便是自己的天下。
王力见陈冲轻描淡写的化解双臂攻势而后一掌攻入破绽，不由自主的喝了一声彩；
然而其他的拳手见陈冲毫无防备的便让彭维的腿欺到近前，都知道大局已定，露出“不过如此”的表情。
感受着接近胸口的凛凛风声，彭维反倒露出一丝笑容。
只要自己的腿一扫，这一掌都不知道飞到哪里去了，毕竟腿可比手长得多，更不用说他体型更占优势。
看着陈冲的双眼，他眼睛一瞪，喝了一声“下去！”
他身子一矮，左腿猛地勾扫陈冲的右脚后脚跟，同时右腿发力，准备欺身而上，一气呵成的赢得胜利！
啪！
一声脆响，彭维的脸结结实实的挨了一巴掌，顿时仰面倒在地上，捂住了鼻子。
而陈冲则站在原地动都没动，有些意外的看着彭维自己将脸撞了过来，又看了看脚下，若有所思。
像是空气在这一瞬间都被抽离。
练功房的喧嚣一下就停了。
拳手们不可思议的看着站着的陈冲和躺着的彭维，一时没明白发生了什么。
这彭维，怎么没扫翻陈冲，反而用自己的脸去碰瓷陈冲的巴掌？
content_en:
Chen Chong and Peng Wei stood opposite each other in the middle of the training room. The noisy boxers moved back as much as possible to make room for them.
About 70% of the formal Thunder Dragon boxers who live in this building are here.
Peng Wei looked at Chen Chong and said in a deep voice
"What I practice is the twisting technique, which is very lethal. If you can't hold it any longer, you should admit defeat as soon as possible. Don't force it."
Chen Chong glanced at him in surprise. He didn't expect him to be so open-minded, so he nodded.
"Okay, you too."
"..."
Peng Wei narrowed his eyes and stopped talking.
As a boxer temporarily acting as a referee shouted "start" from the side, both of them entered the state.
Chen Chong put on the standard "Yu's" fighting style.
The arms are placed on the chest, which can be moved up or down; the feet are placed on the ground alternately, which can be used to attack or defend.
On the opposite side, Peng Wei was obviously different from him. He was obviously much taller than him, but his body was lowered. His long arms were slightly stretched forward, as if he was ready to knock him down at any time.
The two faced each other head-on, maintaining a fixed distance, and began to slowly change positions.
After testing for a moment, Peng Wei nodded slightly. Seeing that Chen Chong had no obvious flaws, he simply stepped forward and closed the distance, reaching for Chen Chong's waist with his arms!
Chen Chong's breathing changed, with a strange rhythm. The blood in his body instantly accelerated, and his strength and reflexes suddenly increased.
He accurately captured the trajectory of Peng Wei's hands. As soon as he opened the arms, he slapped his opponent's forearms with both hands very quickly, slapping the opponent's ape arms away in an instant!
Peng Wei was shocked. He didn't expect that his attack would be blocked so easily, exposing the empty hole in his chest.
Seeing Chen Chong slap him with a palm, he was not afraid, his eyes sparkling.
Opponents who are not familiar with him will think that pulling with his hands is his main force, and try to avoid it; however, those who have fought against him know that his long legs like a python are also a killer move.
The attack on his upper body was neutralized, but his left leg had already reached Chen Chong's feet.
All it takes is a gentle sweep to disrupt his center of gravity, and once he reaches the ground, he has his own world.
Wang Li couldn't help but cheered when he saw Chen Chong calmly defuse the two-arm attack and then attack the opening with one palm;
However, the other boxers saw that Chen Chong was unprepared and let Peng Wei's legs come forward. They all knew that the overall situation was decided and showed "nothing more than that" expressions.
Feeling the sound of the strong wind close to his chest, Peng Wei showed a smile.
As long as he swept his legs, he didn't know where the palm would fly. After all, his legs were much longer than his hands, not to mention that his body shape was more advantageous.
Looking into Chen Chong's eyes, he stared and shouted "Get down!"
He dwarfed, and his left leg suddenly hooked the heel of Chen Chong's right foot. At the same time, he exerted force on his right leg, preparing to bully him and win in one go!
Snap!
There was a crisp sound, and Peng Wei received a solid slap on the face. He immediately fell to the ground on his back and covered his nose.
Chen Chong, on the other hand, stood there without moving. He looked at Peng Wei with some surprise as he bumped his face over, and then looked at his feet, thoughtfully.
It was like the air had been sucked out at this moment.
The noise in the practice room stopped immediately.
The boxers looked at Chen Chong standing and Peng Wei lying down in disbelief, not understanding what was happening.
This Peng Wei, why didn't he sweep away Chen Chong, but instead touched Chen Chong's slap with his own face?
